intentAssessments.title: Private endpoint resources bypass standard ARM templates
intentAssessments.expected: Use the standard PrivateEndpointConnectionResource, PrivateEndpoints, PrivateLink, and PrivateLinks patterns for ARM private endpoint and private link surfaces.
intentAssessments.actual: The intent manually models PrivateEndpointConnection and PrivateLinkResource as ProxyResource types and manually declares their lifecycle interfaces.
intentAssessments.rationale: The emitted operations use standard ARM lifecycle templates, but the resource and operation-group composition does not use the dedicated private endpoint and private link templates documented for this scenario.
